title: Pivot Update Preserves Other Equations
statement: Let $\\nu$ be a finite set of variables, let $E$ and $R$ be equations over $\\mathbb F_2$ on $\\nu$, and let $x:\\nu\\to\\mathbb F_2$ be an assignment. If the coefficient of the pivot variable in $R$ is $0$, then $R$ is satisfied by the assignment obtained by setting the pivot value using $E$ if and only if $R$ is satisfied by $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Pivot equation $E$ and row equation $R$ over $\\mathbb F_2$
Coefficient of the pivot variable in $R$ equals $0$
